purpose: Prevent regressions in the restored Aracne answer lifecycle, visible route weaving, and journal persistence.

cases.given: A route request is answered with speech enabled and the assistant modal is open.
expect: speech synthesis is started with the full Aracne answer
the assistant modal closes shortly after speech begins
closing the modal does not cancel speech synthesis

cases.given: A route has been calculated and pendingAracneMapWeave is true.
expect: closing the assistant modal triggers weaveAracneRoute
a magenta thread is progressively drawn along the route geometry
the final route returns to normal opacity
the answer text is written to aracne_journal_notes
territory, POI or route context is stored when available

cases.given: An Aracne answer is visible in assistantResultText.
expect: Save note stores the visible Aracne answer rather than only the user's prompt

cases.given: Conversation context is queried after a normal turn.
expect: the turn counter increments once per remembered turn
the structured conversation history retains at most four turns
